title: Practical AI Training Programs
heroSubtitle: Hands-on training designed for individuals, entrepreneurs, and organizations looking to apply artificial intelligence tools safely and productively.

sections.heading: Core Training Tracks
sections.body: Each cohort or private team workshop is tailored to real day-to-day tasks rather than abstract theory. Participants practice directly on structured exercises.
bullets: AI Foundations: Understanding capabilities, limitations, and reliable tool selection
Prompt Engineering: Writing clear, repeatable instructions for research, drafting, and synthesis
Business Productivity: Automating repetitive reporting, summaries, and customer documentation
Responsible Verification: Establishing human review checklists for accuracy and privacy

sections.heading: Delivery Formats
sections.body: Programs can be scheduled for individual professionals, small business teams, or institutional departments either remotely or in person.
